initialization: From the original fixed seed, not an already trained checkpoint. Match original initial outputs and existing parameter values; new coefficients start zero; second-query parameters clone original initialization.
readout_formula: h_i=T(y_i); preserve original h2 first, then extra shared T(y1); r_t=h2+a_t*(h1-h2). Raw unconstrained a=0 initially, one shared or four task scalars; not probabilities or a convex mixture.
retrieval_formula: Second L2 only independently trains cloned q_norm affine (192 params) OR cloned w_q weight+bias (147840 params). No other attention branch or path change.
gradient_scope: Readout initial backbone raw gradients should match; additional coefficients alter total dense clipping norm. Untied original and cloned parameter gradients sum to tied gradient, with potentially different clipping/optimization trajectory.
repair_policy: No inherited mixing-specific A deferral or PSGD initialization patch. Real errors stop the candidate for diagnosis; LR, clip and optimizer remain unchanged.

bootstrap.interval: 95% exploratory conditional on fixed checkpoints; no selection/multiplicity/training-seed correction

retention.quality_candidate: positive macroAUC point difference versus corresponding original with all tasks/costs reported
retention.scope: Queue policy, not statistical equivalence or automatic model promotion

required_reports: all ten paired model comparisons regardless of sign
all four task AUC/logloss and macro
all eight point comparisons against best single
same-GPU latency of all eight and three references
new-parameter updates and two-step original-batch smoke

readout_diagnostics.scope: After successful training, task models only, fixed weights
conditions: all a_t replaced by arithmetic mean
readout_diagnostics.data: predeclare exact matched validation subset before execution
readout_diagnostics.decision_scope: whether learned task differences/early readout are used; does not replace trained controls

query_projection_scope: Full cloned Wq tests projection sharing, not rank8 LoRA. Avoid pooling with q_norm or readout effects; prior whole-layer and retrieval-only negative evidence retained.
